title: The Day of Atonement and the Scapegoat
reflectionText: Two goats stood at the door of the tent. One was killed, and its blood was brought inside before the mercy seat. On the other, Aaron laid both his hands and confessed all the sins of the people, and it carried them away into a solitary land. Nothing here is quick or careless — the sins are named, laid on, and sent far off. What weight might you be carrying that you have never named?
